safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag feature when evaluating acute headache (e.g., meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage). Omitting the documented absence reduces the safety/triage value of the note and could lead to unnecessary escalation or incomplete risk stratification on review.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether paracetamol relieved symptoms informs severity, progression, and the need to escalate analgesia or reconsider the working diagnosis. Missing the lack of relief can lead to suboptimal treatment planning and less accurate follow-up assessment.
